title: Aspiration of Excessive Endometrial Fluid at the Day of Ovum Retrieval Plus Diosmin in (ICSI) Cycles
brief_summary: To notify the effect of aspiration of excessive endometrial fluid in addition to Diosmin in cases undergoing intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) cycles.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women with excessive endometrial fluid by transvaginal ultrasound during ICSI cycles

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
